buildings.name: Emily Wilding Davison Building
buildings.function: Library, Student Services Centre, Careers and Enterprise Hub, exhibition space
buildings.evidence: Official 'How to find us': the Visitors' Centre in Founder's central entrance is opposite the Emily Wilding Davison Building; Founder's Square links the two (official places-of-interest page). This is the building directly across from Founder's north-east front; the original project also placed the library here.
